author: Derrick M.
text: Got tattooed by Darin at Riot Gallery. Unbelievable precision. He was super attentive to the placement and the shop inside Pikes Peak Harley is spotless. Best tattoo in Colorado Springs hands down.

author: Kelsey W.
text: Amazing vibe and phenomenal fine-line detail. The artists are true professionals who make you feel completely welcome. No attitude whatsoever.

author: Brandon T.
text: The artwork is top tier, 5 stars on quality. Giving 3 stars because booking communication was really slow and we started 35 minutes late. Incredible artist though.

author: Samantha L.
text: Clean setup, awesome music, and very gentle hands. My botanical sternum piece healed like a dream. Highly recommend booking well in advance!
